*A customer reports a broken app at 12:59 a.m. By 2:35 a.m. the fix is live, and two AI agents handled most of the work by messaging each other.*

Most AI tools still make you the *go-between*, carrying context from one tab to the next. These agents live inside your messaging apps, *remember* how you work, and hand tasks to each other.

What you'll learn:
✅ How an agent carries your *preferences* from Telegram to WhatsApp
✅ The 2 a.m. *handoff* where one agent briefs another in writing
✅ How two teammates on two apps share one agent and skip the meeting

Wait until you hear the *one-word answer* the agent gave at 2:35 a.m.

#AI #AIAgents #FutureOfWork
